title: Diversity Beats Compute: Replicating Ensemble Monitoring on a Budget

original_idea.body: On ControlArena trajectories compare a single mid-size monitor vs an ensemble of small diverse monitors under a fixed token budget via ROC/AUC, testing whether diversity predicts ensemble gains.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Validating diverse-ensemble monitoring lets low-resource actors build strong monitors.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Single vs ensemble monitors at fixed budget on ControlArena, ROC/AUC; clear methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused single-vs-ensemble comparison; uses existing trajectories.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Cheap-monitors-for-constrained-actors is the counterfactual sweet spot; replication is third-party scrutiny.

low_compute.reasoning: Small open monitors under a fixed token budget.

novelty.reasoning: Direct replication of a June 2026 paper; replication value but not novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Replication of an existing claim; the open-model check adds value but the result exists.
